name: Arru
tagline: Track what you spend, shop by shop
description:
Arru keeps a record of your shopping. Each trip is a basket, and inside it you can note the individual items with their shop, category and producer, or just log the total if that is all you have time for. Over a few weeks it turns into a clear picture of where the money actually goes.

Charts rank your categories and shops by how much you have spent, and because prices are tied to shops you can see where a thing costs less. Duplicate shops, products, producers or categories can be merged when your records get untidy, and there are local backups and a data export so your history stays yours.

Everything is kept on the phone. The developer warns that a copy on Google Play is not theirs; the official builds come from GitHub and IzzyOnDroid.
